title: 2004 AMC 10A Problem 13
statement: At a party, each man danced with exactly three women and each woman danced with exactly two men. Twelve men attended the party. How many women attended the party?

solutions.text:
The number of dancing pairs is \(12 \cdot 3 = 36,\) counting from the men’s side. Each woman was in exactly \(2\) pairs, so the number of women is \[ \dfrac{36}{2} = 18. \]

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Count the man-woman dancing pairs in two ways
There are \(12 \cdot 3\) pairs, and each woman accounts for \(2\) of them
